heroHeadline: Kim Jong-un Personally Honors Naegohyang Women's FC Champions; Satellite Imagery Points to Imminent Xi Jinping State Visit
heroSubtitle: Kim Jong-un met Naegohyang Women's FC players on June 2, honoring their historic AFC Women's Champions League title won on South Korean soil — the first North Korean club to win the continental crown and the team's first visit to the South in 8 years. Separately, satellite imagery published June 1 shows a reviewing stand under construction at Kim Il Sung Square and Air Koryo aircraft repositioned at Sunan Airport, strongly suggesting preparations for an imminent Xi Jinping state visit to Pyongyang, which would be China's first since June 2019. The week also saw North Korea conduct its 8th weapons tests of 2026 (AI-guided tactical cruise missiles and Hwasong-11D, May 26–27), prompting a May 29 joint statement from 11 nations condemning DPRK maritime sanctions evasion. The Choe Hyon destroyer remains on track for mid-June commissioning.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
